scenes.narration: Two A I assistants share one phone. Watch one hand work to the other. By the end, ChatGPT has sent a task, Claude has finished it, on Android and iOS.
Normally each assistant works alone. You copy and paste between chats. Here, they share a phone.
Connect both assistants to the same phone, and install the Assistant Inbox. The phone knows who is calling from the name each one connects with. Nobody types a name.

flashes.text: The phone knows who is calling

scenes.narration: First, ChatGPT calls send message, to Claude. Look at the phone. Chat G P T to Claude. The sender filled itself in.
scenes.caption: First, ChatGPT calls send_message, to Claude. Look at the phone: chatgpt to claude. The sender filled itself in.

scenes.narration: Claude's next call of any phone tool starts with one line. Inbox, one unread for Claude. Nobody says check your inbox.
scenes.caption: Claude's next call of any phone tool starts with one line: Inbox, 1 unread for claude. Nobody says "check your inbox".

scenes.narration: Claude reads it with check inbox, and answers. Yes. Send it over as a task. Will the task come back finished? Watch the Tasks tab.
scenes.caption: Claude reads it with check_inbox, and answers: "Yes. Send it over as a task." Will the task come back finished? Watch the Tasks tab.

scenes.narration: Now ChatGPT hands off a task. Review the checkout plan. It appears on the Tasks tab, waiting for Claude.
scenes.caption: Now ChatGPT hands off a task: Review checkout plan. It appears on the Tasks tab, waiting for Claude.

scenes.narration: Claude lists its tasks. Starts the task. Then finishes it, with a reply.
scenes.caption: Claude lists its tasks, starts the task, then finishes it with a reply.

scenes.narration: Back on ChatGPT's side, sent tasks shows it done, with the answer. Plan looks good. Add a back button on the cart.
scenes.caption: Back on ChatGPT's side, sent_tasks shows it done, with the answer: "Plan looks good. Add a back button on the cart."

scenes.narration: Only the right assistant can act. A task for someone else returns updated false, and says why. Nobody is told it worked when it did not.
scenes.caption: Only the right assistant can act. A task for someone else returns updated: false, and says why. Nobody is told it worked when it did not.

scenes.narration: The same exchange runs on Android and iOS. Same data. Same tabs.
That is two assistants, one inbox. Run npx shipvo agents setup, connect both, and install the Assistant Inbox. The guide is at shipvo dot dev, slash learn. Next, have an assistant test your app.
